personality_one_liner: A high-visibility, tactical command center optimized for nocturnal driving and zero-friction data entry.

spacing.rule: Use sm/md spacing strictly. Interface must feel like a live operational surface with fast scanning and immediate hierarchy.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary and borders instead to maintain clarity
dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism on dense data screens or in Dark-First Utility as clarity beats aesthetic

screens.name: Resumo
screens.purpose: A command-center dashboard for a quick glance at daily and monthly KM progress.

states.empty: No trips logged this month yet. Big 'Nova Viagem' CTA.
states.error: Failed to load metrics. Retry button.

screens.layout: Top hero section featuring a dark dashboard photo background with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse/black). Large display typography (Barlow Condensed) showing total 'KM do Mês'. Below, a 2-column grid for 'KM de Hoje' and 'Viagens no Mês' using metric cards. Stacked modules with high-contrast orange progress indicators.

screens.name: Nova Viagem
screens.purpose: A high-contrast, fast-entry form for logging a new trip with minimal friction.

states.error: Validation errors highlighted with red borders.

screens.layout: Single-column scroll view. Labels above inputs (never floating). Use surfaceTertiary for input backgrounds with borderStrong for focus states. Group inputs logically: Date/Time (Start & End), Odometer (KM Inicial & Final), and Locations (Carregamento & Descanso). Primary CTA 'Salvar Viagem' is sticky at the bottom over the keyboard.

screens.name: Histórico
screens.purpose: Review and manage past trips in a clear, chronologically stacked list.

states.empty: Dark atmospheric empty state background with text 'Nenhuma viagem registrada'.

screens.layout: Sticky header with a month filter. Full-width stacked trip cards separated by dividers (shadow 0). Each card displays the Date prominently, followed by a compact grid of Start/End time, Calculated KM Total, and locations. A swipe-to-delete action reveals a high-contrast red background with a delete icon.

empty_state_history.alt: Empty road at night under street lamps

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility (Personality 7) guidelines. Use #121212 as the base surface, avoiding pure black to prevent contrast fatigue during long driving sessions.
Do NOT use glassmorphism or blur effects. Use solid surfaceSecondary and borders for separation to maintain operational clarity and high performance.
Prioritize legibility and large touch targets (minimum 44x44pt). Drivers may use this in a moving vehicle or under stress.
Ensure the hero image on the Resumo screen uses a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to 80% or more of #121212) so the overlaid 'KM do Mês' metric is extremely legible.
Use Barlow Condensed for all numeric metrics and display titles to create a technical, dashboard-like feel. Use DM Sans for form labels and body text.
The 'Nova Viagem' CTA must be pinned at the bottom of the screen above the safe area, remaining visible while the user scrolls through the form.
